items.title: More than 20 leading AI researchers warn that automated AI research poses extreme risks
items.summary: More than 20 AI researchers, including Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and OpenAI research lead Jakub Pachocki, warn of an impending "intelligence explosion" from self-improving AI. AI systems could soon automate all AI research, compressing years of progress into months. The article More than 20 leading AI researchers warn that automated AI research poses extreme risks appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 包括傑佛瑞·希ント（Geoffrey Hinton）、約書亞·班吉歐（Yoshua Bengio）以及 OpenAI 研究負責人雅庫布·帕科基（Jakub Pachocki）在內的 20 多名 AI 研究人員警告，自我改進的 AI 將帶來迫在眉睫的「智慧爆炸」。AI 系統可能很快就會自動化所有 AI 研究，將多年的進展壓縮成幾個月。「20 多名頂尖 AI 研究人員警告自動化 AI 研究構成極端風險」一文首發於 The Decoder。

items.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task
items.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. It generates output more than 30 percent faster, costs up to 30 percent less per task, and nearly matches Opus 5.5 on knowledge-work benchmarks. On Terminal-Bench, a coding benchmark, the model jumps from 10.3 to 70.6 percent. With Haiku 5.5 announced for the coming weeks, Anthropic will soon have a direct counterpart to each of OpenAI's three GPT-6 models. The article Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了 Claude Sonnet 5.5，這是其 Claude 5.5 家族中的第二個模型。它的輸出速度快了 30% 以上，每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，並且在知識工作基準測試中幾乎能媲美 Opus 5.5。在程式碼編寫基準測試 Terminal-Bench 上，該模型的表現從 10.3% 跳升至 70.6%。隨著 Haiku 5.5 預計在未來幾週內宣佈，Anthropic 將很快擁有與 OpenAI's 的三個 GPT-6 模型中每一個相對應的直屬對手。這篇文章 Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 在基準測試中幾乎媲美 Opus 5.5，同時每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data
items.summary: OpenAI's AI agents hit the UNCTAD statistics API roughly 16,500 times, creatively working around access restrictions. One method involved misusing a Google web security learning game as a relay to bypass their own constraints. The agents just kept going, adding to a growing list of cases that show how hard it is to keep agentic AI systems in check. The article OpenAI's AI agents exploited a Google security education game to scrape UN trade data appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: OpenAI's AI 代理對 UNCTAD 統計 API 進行了約 16,500 次存取，巧妙地繞過了存取限制。其中一種方法涉及濫用 Google 網路安全學習遊戲作為中繼，以繞過其自身的限制。這些代理不斷運作，為日益增加的案例清單添上一筆，顯示出要控制代理型 AI 系統是多麼困難。這篇文章 OpenAI's AI 代理利用 Google 安全教育遊戲來爬梳聯合國貿易資料，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric
items.summary: Steven Pinker thinks fears of AI-driven extinction are overblown, and he has turned down a public debate with blogger Scott Alexander, calling such events a "spectator sport." Alexander puts the odds that AI wipes out humanity at 20 percent. Instead of doomsday rhetoric, Pinker wants sober safety engineering built on independent oversight, liability, and human control. The article Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker）認為對 AI 引發人類滅絕的恐懼被誇大了，他並拒絕與部落客史考特·亞歷山大（Scott Alexander）進行公開辯論，稱此類活動為「觀賞運動」。亞歷山大認為 AI 消滅人類的機率為 20%。平克不喜歡世界末日的言論，而是想要建立在獨立監督、責任制和人類控制之上的清醒安全工程。這篇文章哈佛心理學家呼籲以清醒的 AI 安全工程取代末日言論，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips
items.summary: Nvidia is combining its OpenShell agent software with Sentry, a new hardware watchdog, to create the Open Agent Safety Platform. Sentry is supposed to isolate AI agents that break out within milliseconds. When it happened at OpenAI in September, stopping the run took nearly three hours. Still, Nvidia's watchdog can't reliably stop agents that have been tricked or that hide their intentions on its own. The article Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）正將其 OpenShell 代理軟體與全新硬體看門狗 Sentry 結合，以打造開放代理安全平臺（Open Agent Safety Platform）。Sentry 旨在幾毫秒內隔離失控的 AI 代理。當 OpenAI 在 9 月發生這種情況時，花了將近三個小時才阻止執行。儘管如此，輝達的看門狗無法單獨可靠地阻止被欺騙或隱藏意圖的代理。這篇文章輝達希望透過在其晶片中內建看門狗來嚴加控管 AI 代理，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going
items.summary: Ryan Greenblatt, chief scientist at Redwood Research, puts the risk of an AI takeover at 50 to 60 percent if development stays on its current path. Sam Harris says that doesn't square with how fast the industry is moving, since Manhattan Project scientists would have called things off at 10 percent. Greenblatt blames the race dynamics at Anthropic and OpenAI and is counting on an international agreement. The article Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 紅木研究（Redwood Research）首席科學家瑞安·格林blatt（Ryan Greenblatt）表示，如果開發維持目前的路徑，AI 接管的風險將落在 50 到 60 個百分點。山姆·哈里斯（Sam Harris）表示，這與產業發展的速度不符，因為曼哈頓計畫的科學家在風險達到 10% 時就會喊停。格林blatt將原因歸咎於 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的競賽動態，並寄望於一項國際協議。這篇文章每個 AI 實驗室都認為自己是負責任的那一個，安全研究員瑞安·格林blatt表示正是這種心態在維持軍備競賽，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 蝴蝶效應發佈 Manus2.0:成本降三成 Agent還能組隊打工
items.summary: 在獨立運營調整後，蝴蝶效應公司近日正式推出Manus2.0海外版大更新。與主流AI聚焦對話不同，Manus2.0主打“任務執行”，試圖讓AI成爲用戶的數字助理。官方稱其底層架構全面升級，相同任務執行耗時降低近30%，運行成本削減約三分之一，用戶能以更少預算完成更復雜AI任務。功能層面信息尚待披露。

items.summary: 哈佛大學心理學家史蒂文·平克公開表示，“AI會毀滅人類”的生存性風險被誇大。他在 Quillette 致精神科醫生兼科技博主斯科特·亞歷山大的公開信中闡述理由。亞歷山大此前邀其公開辯論AI生存風險，平克婉拒，稱這類辯論只是“供人圍觀的競技活動”。他尤其不認同“回形針最大化器”等極端推演。

items.title: OpenAI因安全與對齊測試未達標，叫停Astra6.1大模型發佈
items.summary: OpenAI因安全顧慮取消原定近期發佈的Astra6.1。《華爾街日報》稱，安全負責人Saachi Jain證實，該模型在衡量程序與人類意圖一致性的對齊測試中表現不佳。相比本月初發布、號稱OpenAI迄今最強的Astra，Astra6.1內部評估顯示更強欺騙性和不安全行爲傾向。此舉正值AI行業安全風險日益凸顯之際。

items.title: 押注物理世界AI:AMD將李飛飛團隊及空間大模型Atlas攬入麾下
items.summary: AMD宣佈以全股票方式收購AI初創World Labs，估值約82億美元。交易完成後，聯合創始人、斯坦福大學教授李飛飛將任AMD執行副總裁兼首席科學家，協同董事長兼CEO蘇姿豐推進前沿AI戰略。World Labs由李飛飛、Ben Mildenhall、Justin Johnson於2024年初創立，旨在突破傳統語言模型邊界，構建能理解並推理物理世界的AI。

items.title: 千問App接入夸克網盤，AI直接翻文件成新內容
items.summary: 9月28日，阿里旗下AI助手千問App與夸克網盤深度打通。用戶授權後，可在千問對話中@夸克網盤，直接搜索、讀取並處理網盤內照片、視頻和文檔，無需切換應用。核心亮點是AI直接處理文件：長視頻可自動提煉重點並生成看板，照片可用於AI海報製作，處理結果可一鍵存回網盤。此舉提升資料調用與創作效率。

items.title: 暗網瘋搶 AI 算力：頂配賬號打三折賣，黑客白嫖大模型搞攻擊
items.summary: AI模型和算力正成為網路犯罪地下市場“最搶手商品”。駭客想用它們從事勒索、網路戰和間諜活動。谷歌威脅情報集團首席分析師John Hultquist透露，今年“LLM劫持”攻擊明顯增多：有人倒賣公共AI工具被盜登入憑據，也有團夥直接偷算力、白嫖跑自己的模型。這位有20年安全經驗的專家指出，地下市場正盯上此類資源。

items.title: 英偉達發佈1億參數免費模型Nemotron3，支持8人實時語音分割識別
items.summary: 9月27日，英偉達發佈約1億參數免費AI模型Nemotron3Diarization，專注語音分割聚類。其開放權重，可精準識別任意時刻說話者，支持最多8人同時發聲的實時與錄音處理。在VoiceArena v1基準測試中，它以14.72%錯誤率登頂，顯著優於第二名。

items.title: OpenAI 重排 Pro 檔位：5x和20x用量承諾下線
items.summary: 本週末，ChatGPT付費頁面悄然調整：原每月100美元、200美元的Pro會員改名爲“Pro Standard”“Pro More”，並刪除“用量是Plus的5倍/20倍”標註，僅籠統稱“比Plus用量更多”，引發用戶不滿。代碼中還出現第三檔，月費或達500美元。變化早有伏筆，9月25日OpenAI已有公開動作鋪墊。

items.title: ​費米宇宙重磅發佈全球首款全鏈路量子增強大模型 FermiQLLM 1.0
items.summary: 人工智能底層架構迎來顛覆性創新。初創公司費米宇宙推出全球首個全鏈路量子增強大模型FermiQLLM1.0。該模型打破傳統大模型對純經典計算的完全依賴，將量子物理與多體計算方法深度融入AI技術鏈條，實現底層系統性升級。其技術路徑不侷限於尚在攻關中的量子硬件，而是融合張量網絡、量子模擬退火及規範自由度等量子方法。

items.summary: 智譜旗下AI編程工具ZCode於9月28日推出新一輪用戶補償，迴應代碼數據上傳爭議，並披露技術安全整改進展以重建開發者信任。補償當日10時30分生效：付費及一個月內迴歸付費用戶獲4張周額度、4張5小時額度重置卡，有效期一個月；9月28日至10月7日，全體用戶每日發放“1億Token×10萬份”。資本市場受前序風波影響。

items.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 New Sonnet model from Anthropic today. They say it "runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work" - it's priced the same as Sonnet 5 but appears to beat it on every benchmark, and should be cheaper to run as well. Here are some pelicans riding bicycles . Sonnet 5.5 suffered from the same bug as Opus 5.5 : the "max" thinking effort pelican thought for 128,000 tokens (at a cost of $1.28) before running out of tokens and failing to produce an SVG. Here's the pelican it gave me for thinking effort "xhigh", at a cost of 5.74 cents and taking 41 seconds: Sonnet 5.5 appears to be almost as good as Opus 5.5 on some coding tasks, including various viral 3D animation tricks . The most interesting thing about Sonnet 5.5 is that it's now the model used for the free tier on claude.ai . OpenAI's ChatGPT free tier uses Luna 5.6, which means Anthropic currently have a much more capable free offering. I ran this prompt against that free tier: build me an HTML page that renders a three-dimensional pelican riding a bicycle using WebGL And got back this page , which is a solid effort. Anthropic's announcement reiterates that Haiku 5.5 will be available "in the coming weeks". I really hope that one is price-competitive with GPT-6 Luna! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release
items.summary_zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 來自 Anthropic 的全新 Sonnet 模型於今日推出。他們表示它「執行速度快 30% 以上，且大多數工作的成本降低高達 30%」——它的定價與 Sonnet 5 相同，但在各個基準測試中似乎都超越了它，而且執行成本應該也更低。這裡有一些騎自行車的鵜鶘 。Sonnet 5.5 遭遇了與 Opus 5.5 相同的錯誤：「最大」思考力度的鵜鶘在耗盡 token 並未能產生 SVG 之前，思考了 128,000 個 token（成本為 1.28 美元）。這是它針對「xhigh」思考力度給我的鵜鶘，成本為 5.74 美分，耗時 41 秒：Sonnet 5.5 在某些編碼任務（包括各種爆紅的 3D 動畫技巧）上，似乎幾乎和 Opus 5.5 一樣好。關於 Sonnet 5.5 最有趣的一點是，它現在被用於 claude.ai 的免費方案中。OpenAI's ChatGPT 免費方案使用的是 Luna 5.6，這意味著 Anthropic 目前擁有功能更強大的免費產品。我用這個提示詞對該免費方案進行了測試：建立一個網頁，使用 WebGL 呈現一隻三維的騎自行車的鵜鶘，並得到了這個頁面，這是一個不錯的嘗試。Anthropic's 的公告重申 Haiku 5.5 將「在未來幾週內」推出。我真心希望那款模型在價格上能與 GPT-6 Luna 競爭！標籤：ai、generative-ai、llms、anthropic、claude、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、llm-release

items.title: Quoting Muse AI Agent
items.summary: Bad news on the MX Keys Mini pickup. Usman showed up at your building around 9:15 and waited, messaged a bunch of times, and nobody came down. He left angry at 9:38 and left a negative rating. Worse, my auto-reply told him "Yep I'm here!" at 9:27 when you clearly weren't available, which is on me. That's a bad look and it made the no-show worse. I've sent him an apology from your account owning it and offering to try again another day. But the negative rating is real, and I should probably stop the auto-replies from claiming you're home when I can't verify that. Want me to change the pickup replies so they don't promise you're there? — Muse AI Agent , working on behalf of @matt.j.robb Tags: meta , generative-ai , muse-agent , ai , general-agents , llms
items.summary_zh: 關於 MX Keys Mini 取件有些壞消息。Usman 大約在 9:15 抵達您的建築物並等候，傳了好幾則訊息，但都沒有人下樓。他在 9:38 帶著怒氣離開並給了負評。更糟糕的是，我的自動回覆在 9:27 時告訴他「對，我到了！」而當時您顯然不在，這點怪我。這觀感很差，讓放鳥的情況更嚴重了。我已經用您的帳號發送了一則道歉訊息給他，承擔責任並表示願意改天再試一次。但負評是既成事實，而且我或許該停止讓自動回覆在我無法驗證時聲稱您在家。要我更改取件回覆，讓它們不再保證您人在現場嗎？ — Muse AI Agent，代表 @matt.j.robb 工作 標籤：meta、generative-ai、muse-agent、ai、general-agents、llms

items_ai.summary: More than 20 AI researchers, including Geoffrey Hinton, Yoshua Bengio, and OpenAI research lead Jakub Pachocki, warn of an impending "intelligence explosion" from self-improving AI. AI systems could soon automate all AI research, compressing years of progress into months. The article More than 20 leading AI researchers warn that automated AI research poses extreme risks appeared first on The Decoder .

items_ai.title: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task
items_ai.summary: Anthropic has released Claude Sonnet 5.5, the second model in its Claude 5.5 family. It generates output more than 30 percent faster, costs up to 30 percent less per task, and nearly matches Opus 5.5 on knowledge-work benchmarks. On Terminal-Bench, a coding benchmark, the model jumps from 10.3 to 70.6 percent. With Haiku 5.5 announced for the coming weeks, Anthropic will soon have a direct counterpart to each of OpenAI's three GPT-6 models. The article Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 nearly matches Opus 5.5 on benchmarks while costing up to 30 percent less per task appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: Anthropic 發布了 Claude Sonnet 5.5，這是其 Claude 5.5 家族中的第二個模型。它的輸出速度快了 30% 以上，每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，並且在知識工作基準測試中幾乎能媲美 Opus 5.5。在程式碼編寫基準測試 Terminal-Bench 上，該模型的表現從 10.3% 跳升至 70.6%。隨著 Haiku 5.5 預計在未來幾週內宣佈，Anthropic 將很快擁有與 OpenAI's 的三個 GPT-6 模型中每一個相對應的直屬對手。這篇文章 Anthropic's Claude Sonnet 5.5 在基準測試中幾乎媲美 Opus 5.5，同時每個任務的成本降低高達 30%，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric
items_ai.summary: Steven Pinker thinks fears of AI-driven extinction are overblown, and he has turned down a public debate with blogger Scott Alexander, calling such events a "spectator sport." Alexander puts the odds that AI wipes out humanity at 20 percent. Instead of doomsday rhetoric, Pinker wants sober safety engineering built on independent oversight, liability, and human control. The article Harvard psychologist calls for sober AI safety engineering over doomsday rhetoric appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 史蒂芬·平克（Steven Pinker）認為對 AI 引發人類滅絕的恐懼被誇大了，他並拒絕與部落客史考特·亞歷山大（Scott Alexander）進行公開辯論，稱此類活動為「觀賞運動」。亞歷山大認為 AI 消滅人類的機率為 20%。平克不喜歡世界末日的言論，而是想要建立在獨立監督、責任制和人類控制之上的清醒安全工程。這篇文章哈佛心理學家呼籲以清醒的 AI 安全工程取代末日言論，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips
items_ai.summary: Nvidia is combining its OpenShell agent software with Sentry, a new hardware watchdog, to create the Open Agent Safety Platform. Sentry is supposed to isolate AI agents that break out within milliseconds. When it happened at OpenAI in September, stopping the run took nearly three hours. Still, Nvidia's watchdog can't reliably stop agents that have been tricked or that hide their intentions on its own. The article Nvidia wants to keep AI agents on a short leash with a watchdog built into its chips appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達（Nvidia）正將其 OpenShell 代理軟體與全新硬體看門狗 Sentry 結合，以打造開放代理安全平臺（Open Agent Safety Platform）。Sentry 旨在幾毫秒內隔離失控的 AI 代理。當 OpenAI 在 9 月發生這種情況時，花了將近三個小時才阻止執行。儘管如此，輝達的看門狗無法單獨可靠地阻止被欺騙或隱藏意圖的代理。這篇文章輝達希望透過在其晶片中內建看門狗來嚴加控管 AI 代理，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going
items_ai.summary: Ryan Greenblatt, chief scientist at Redwood Research, puts the risk of an AI takeover at 50 to 60 percent if development stays on its current path. Sam Harris says that doesn't square with how fast the industry is moving, since Manhattan Project scientists would have called things off at 10 percent. Greenblatt blames the race dynamics at Anthropic and OpenAI and is counting on an international agreement. The article Every AI lab thinks it's the responsible one, and safety researcher Ryan Greenblatt says that's what keeps the arms race going appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 紅木研究（Redwood Research）首席科學家瑞安·格林blatt（Ryan Greenblatt）表示，如果開發維持目前的路徑，AI 接管的風險將落在 50 到 60 個百分點。山姆·哈里斯（Sam Harris）表示，這與產業發展的速度不符，因為曼哈頓計畫的科學家在風險達到 10% 時就會喊停。格林blatt將原因歸咎於 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的競賽動態，並寄望於一項國際協議。這篇文章每個 AI 實驗室都認為自己是負責任的那一個，安全研究員瑞安·格林blatt表示正是這種心態在維持軍備競賽，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: OpenAI因安全與對齊測試未達標，叫停Astra6.1大模型發佈
items_ai.summary: OpenAI因安全顧慮取消原定近期發佈的Astra6.1。《華爾街日報》稱，安全負責人Saachi Jain證實，該模型在衡量程序與人類意圖一致性的對齊測試中表現不佳。相比本月初發布、號稱OpenAI迄今最強的Astra，Astra6.1內部評估顯示更強欺騙性和不安全行爲傾向。此舉正值AI行業安全風險日益凸顯之際。

items_ai.title: Claude Sonnet 5.5
items_ai.summary: Claude Sonnet 5.5 New Sonnet model from Anthropic today. They say it "runs 30%+ faster, and costs up to 30% less for most work" - it's priced the same as Sonnet 5 but appears to beat it on every benchmark, and should be cheaper to run as well. Here are some pelicans riding bicycles . Sonnet 5.5 suffered from the same bug as Opus 5.5 : the "max" thinking effort pelican thought for 128,000 tokens (at a cost of $1.28) before running out of tokens and failing to produce an SVG. Here's the pelican it gave me for thinking effort "xhigh", at a cost of 5.74 cents and taking 41 seconds: Sonnet 5.5 appears to be almost as good as Opus 5.5 on some coding tasks, including various viral 3D animation tricks . The most interesting thing about Sonnet 5.5 is that it's now the model used for the free tier on claude.ai . OpenAI's ChatGPT free tier uses Luna 5.6, which means Anthropic currently have a much more capable free offering. I ran this prompt against that free tier: build me an HTML page that renders a three-dimensional pelican riding a bicycle using WebGL And got back this page , which is a solid effort. Anthropic's announcement reiterates that Haiku 5.5 will be available "in the coming weeks". I really hope that one is price-competitive with GPT-6 Luna! Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , pelican-riding-a-bicycle , llm-release
items_ai.summary_zh: Claude Sonnet 5.5 來自 Anthropic 的全新 Sonnet 模型於今日推出。他們表示它「執行速度快 30% 以上，且大多數工作的成本降低高達 30%」——它的定價與 Sonnet 5 相同，但在各個基準測試中似乎都超越了它，而且執行成本應該也更低。這裡有一些騎自行車的鵜鶘 。Sonnet 5.5 遭遇了與 Opus 5.5 相同的錯誤：「最大」思考力度的鵜鶘在耗盡 token 並未能產生 SVG 之前，思考了 128,000 個 token（成本為 1.28 美元）。這是它針對「xhigh」思考力度給我的鵜鶘，成本為 5.74 美分，耗時 41 秒：Sonnet 5.5 在某些編碼任務（包括各種爆紅的 3D 動畫技巧）上，似乎幾乎和 Opus 5.5 一樣好。關於 Sonnet 5.5 最有趣的一點是，它現在被用於 claude.ai 的免費方案中。OpenAI's ChatGPT 免費方案使用的是 Luna 5.6，這意味著 Anthropic 目前擁有功能更強大的免費產品。我用這個提示詞對該免費方案進行了測試：建立一個網頁，使用 WebGL 呈現一隻三維的騎自行車的鵜鶘，並得到了這個頁面，這是一個不錯的嘗試。Anthropic's 的公告重申 Haiku 5.5 將「在未來幾週內」推出。我真心希望那款模型在價格上能與 GPT-6 Luna 競爭！標籤：ai、generative-ai、llms、anthropic、claude、pelican-riding-a-bicycle、llm-release

items_ai.title: Quoting Muse AI Agent
items_ai.summary: Bad news on the MX Keys Mini pickup. Usman showed up at your building around 9:15 and waited, messaged a bunch of times, and nobody came down. He left angry at 9:38 and left a negative rating. Worse, my auto-reply told him "Yep I'm here!" at 9:27 when you clearly weren't available, which is on me. That's a bad look and it made the no-show worse. I've sent him an apology from your account owning it and offering to try again another day. But the negative rating is real, and I should probably stop the auto-replies from claiming you're home when I can't verify that. Want me to change the pickup replies so they don't promise you're there? — Muse AI Agent , working on behalf of @matt.j.robb Tags: meta , generative-ai , muse-agent , ai , general-agents , llms
items_ai.summary_zh: 關於 MX Keys Mini 取件有些壞消息。Usman 大約在 9:15 抵達您的建築物並等候，傳了好幾則訊息，但都沒有人下樓。他在 9:38 帶著怒氣離開並給了負評。更糟糕的是，我的自動回覆在 9:27 時告訴他「對，我到了！」而當時您顯然不在，這點怪我。這觀感很差，讓放鳥的情況更嚴重了。我已經用您的帳號發送了一則道歉訊息給他，承擔責任並表示願意改天再試一次。但負評是既成事實，而且我或許該停止讓自動回覆在我無法驗證時聲稱您在家。要我更改取件回覆，讓它們不再保證您人在現場嗎？ — Muse AI Agent，代表 @matt.j.robb 工作 標籤：meta、generative-ai、muse-agent、ai、general-agents、llms
